claude.performance_metric: bought out remaining 49% for ~$16.7bn ~26 months after closing; NBCU OIBDA +15.2% to $4.7bn in 2013; no goodwill impairment
claude.rationale: The slice documents a positive realized trajectory with no product/process disruption: NBCUniversal operating income before D&A grew 15.2% to $4.7 billion in 2013 and consolidated revenue and net income grew each year 2011-2013, with no reported goodwill impairment—so p4_pathway is 0. Nothing in the slice describes any operations-versus-people/management/culture fracture; instead Comcast accelerated to full ownership by buying out GE's 49% interest ahead of schedule in March 2013, indicating no documented process/organization breakdown—so p5_pathway is 0. The only governance item (relinquishing Hulu voting rights and board seat) was a regulatory condition, not an internal integration fracture, and no archetype incoherence or business-model incompatibility is documented.
